tier_reason: benchmark_url is null, and the Bitbucket Benchmarks wiki (and every wiki page tried) returns 404 here. The repo has the Blazemark suite (blazemark/, whose Configfile can enable Eigen, MKL/BLAS, Armadillo, Boost uBLAS, Blitz++, GMM++, FLENS and MTL) but no result numbers, so no Blaze-vs-baseline number was seen. The only third-party numbers opened (Fastor's wiki) show Blaze slower than Fastor and state no Blaze-vs-Eigen result.

corrections.baseline: Eigen, Intel MKL/BLAS and other C++ linear-algebra libraries: the Blazemark suite's Configfile has switches for BLAS (MKL), Boost uBLAS, Blitz++, GMM++, Armadillo, FLENS, MTL and Eigen. The result pages (Bitbucket Benchmarks wiki) were unreachable, so the comparison set actually published is unconfirmed.
corrections.stars_or_usage: vcpkg port blaze 3.8.2 (port-version 1); Conan Center recipe versions 3.7, 3.8 and 3.8.2; read-only GitHub mirror live-clones/blaze has 12 stars and 4 forks; latest release 3.8.2 (2020-08-15)
corrections.caveats: Tier D: the Bitbucket wiki Benchmarks page returned 404 to this verifier as well, so no number could be checked. The benchmark code itself (blazemark/) is in the repo. The one third-party benchmark opened (Fastor wiki: Blaze 3.7 vs Eigen 3.3.7, MKL JIT, LIBXSMM and Fastor on small fixed-size matrix products) says Blaze with padding is 'in general being about 50% slower' than Fastor and 'over 2X slower in some cases', and that Blaze without padding falls back to scalar remainder code. The canonical Bitbucket repo's last commit is 2024-12-30 (Bitbucket API), the same as the mirror, and there has been no release since 3.8.2 in 2020. The peer-reviewed SIAM SISC 2012 paper by Iglberger et al. ('Expression Templates Revisited') benchmarks Blaze, but its PDF host was egress-blocked; a search summary suggests it shows MKL-level parity for dgemm rather than a win.

notes: Confirmed at D rather than rejected: Blaze is widely referenced (vcpkg and Conan ports, mirrors, a CRAN wrapper in search results) even though the mirror has few stars. A retier check could open the Blaze Benchmarks wiki or the SISC 2012 paper if Bitbucket wiki or blogs.fau.de becomes reachable. A WebSearch snippet (HN thread, not opened) says the Blaze benchmarks date from 2016-17 and that Eigen ran without its MKL backend; this is unverified. License BSD-3-Clause was confirmed from the mirror's LICENSE ('New (Revised) BSD') and the vcpkg manifest.
